title: GEDI Researchers Explain How Forests Can Fight Climate Change
excerpt: Dr. Laura Duncanson and Professor Ralph Dubayah featured in The New York Times discussing how GEDI's spaceborne lidar is transforming our understanding of forest height, structure, and carbon storage — and why forests are critical to climate solutions.

title: NASA Releases Breakthrough Forest Biomass-Carbon Product
excerpt: NASA officially releases the GEDI Level-4B gridded aboveground biomass density map — a global product co-developed by the LEAF LAB team, providing the most comprehensive forest carbon map from space.

title: From Space to Soil: How NASA Sees Forests
excerpt: Dr. Duncanson narrates a NASA Scientific Visualization Studio feature explaining how spaceborne lidar captures the 3-D architecture of forests — from the International Space Station to individual tree canopies.

title: A Breakthrough Technology Shoots Laser Beams at Trees from the ISS
excerpt: Feature on GEDI's revolutionary approach to measuring global forest structure — shooting billions of laser pulses at Earth's forests from the International Space Station to map carbon stocks no satellite had reached before.

title: Protected Areas Safeguard Climate
excerpt: LEAF LAB research reveals that global protected areas store significantly more carbon than unprotected forests — providing the first satellite-based proof that conservation policy delivers measurable climate benefits.

title: Forest Biomass Estimation from Space — New Estimates, Challenges, and Future Opportunities
excerpt: Dr. Duncanson presents at the Oxford Centre for Tropical Forests, covering the latest GEDI results, remaining challenges in biomass estimation, and the roadmap for next-generation spaceborne lidar missions.

title: Mapping Forest Aboveground Carbon Content with New NASA Lidar Missions
excerpt: Public lecture by Prof. Duncanson covering GEDI and ICESat-2 science results, methodological innovations in spaceborne biomass estimation, and the path toward a complete global forest carbon inventory.
